constraints: Each ORDER BY ATTRIBUTE call sorts on exactly one level (one objectField/attributePath pair); for multi-level sorts, call the command repeatedly with the optional trailing '*' on every call except the last, which starts the actual sort.
Can be combined with ORDER BY calls in the same multi-level sort chain.
Only attributes containing scalar values (number, text, boolean, date) can be sorted; an array element in attributePath is an error.
If the field attribute is null for a record, null values sort first in ascending order (>) and last in descending order (<).
If a single indexed field is specified (one-level sort), the index is used; otherwise (unindexed field, or more than one level) the sort is performed sequentially.
If aTable is omitted, the command applies to the default table if one is set, otherwise to the table of the first field passed.
